about: Permanent plants for tests/support/shuffle-opt-out-scan.ts (#4611 review r1). Each entry is a source the gate reads; `accepted` must be admitted and produce no finding, every other entry is a spelling of vitest's shuffle suite option that the gate cannot attribute and must red. Data, not a test file: the census scans the tracked tests tree for the option, so a plant written as a .ts file here would red the gate that reads it (and tests/fixtures/** is not collected by vitest either). Keep `expectedFindings` exact: lowering a gate branch without deleting a plant reds the mismatch.

plants.name: accepted
plants.why: the one admitted spelling: a literal options object holding only the bare shuffle key, set to false, passed directly to a live describe

plants.name: quoted-key
plants.why: a quoted key is honoured by vitest and invisible to a scanner that blanks string contents (#4611 review r1 M2)
plants.source:
import { describe } from "vitest";

describe("plant quoted", { "shuffle": false }, () => {});

plants.name: computed-key
plants.why: a computed key is honoured by vitest, and reads as no key at all to a text-only scanner (#4611 review r1 M2)
plants.source:
import { describe } from "vitest";

describe("plant computed", { ["shuffle"]: false }, () => {});

plants.name: computed-key-from-variable
plants.why: a computed key whose name is a value: no property-position text spells the option, so only the structural read can see it

plants.name: bound-in-support-module
plants.why: an options object bound in a non-test module was never read at all: scanning .test.ts files only left it green (#4611 review r1 M2)
plants.source:
/** A shared suite-options object, as a support module might export one. */
export const SUITE_OPTIONS = { shuffle: false };

plants.name: options-imported
plants.why: the use site names the options through an identifier, so a per-file text scan of the describe call sees nothing (#4611 review r1 M2)

plants.name: spread-options
plants.why: a describe that spreads another object can carry the opt-out from anywhere; neither the spread site nor its source is attributable

plants.name: other-options-beside
plants.why: the gate admits one literal object holding the shuffle key alone; a second option means a reader must reason about which properties vitest honours
plants.source:
import { describe } from "vitest";

describe("plant extra options", { timeout: 5000, shuffle: false }, () => {});

plants.name: wrapped-in-skip
plants.why: a registered describe inside a skipped suite keeps its registry row valid while the run includes none of it (#4611 review r1 LOW-4)
